verdict.rationale: Filee is a desktop file converter for Windows, Linux and a macOS preview. It installs as an app or runs from a portable ZIP, and nothing in the evidence describes conversion running inside a web browser. A browser-based converter is a fair thing to ask of a file converter, so the axis applies. Dragging files out of Chrome or Firefox into the app, and the "Nothing to install" line (which refers to vCard conversion needing no extra engine), are adjacent features, not in-browser conversion.

support.subject: As a power user, a one-off conversion works in the browser with nothing installed
